capital-three-states-collapsed-into-two._: Treat 'nobody typed a figure' as 'the figure is short'. The screen then tells an office it is undercapitalised when nobody entered a number — a finding about its capital made out of a missing fact. Must kill the different-facts test.

the-expiry-warning-never-renders._: Art. 10/b's warning disabled. The CONDITION, not the block — deleting the JSX would break the page and kill every test, which proves nothing about which test observes what. Must kill the expiry test alone.

the-servers-refusal-becomes-a-generic-se._: Replace the API's own message with the screen's generic one. A duplicate establishment number then reads identically to an art. 3/a breach, and the second needs a different person to fix it. Must kill the server-refusal test.

the-permission-check-is-dropped._: The screen renders its form to a reader who cannot submit it — a control that leads to a refusal, which this product's own directive forbids. Must kill the refusal test.
